about: The songs on this site. Each entry is a song in our Suno library, played through Suno's own embed player (https://suno.com/embed/<id>). To make this site your own, fork the repository and replace these entries with your own public Suno songs. stage is experiment or pre-release.
source: Read from the team's Suno library through Suno's MCP connection by suno.b@SovereignWebsite.dinis on 23 November 2026 (all 30 made public at Dinis Cruz's word in its session). Style notes are shortened from the prompts.
